info.description: REST API for Flexify.IO Management Server
info.title: Flexify.IO Management API

get.summary: Get the current company administrator's company
Get sign-in, MFA, OIDC provider and partner access settings of the current company

put.summary: Update sign-in, MFA, OIDC provider and partner access settings of the current company

get.summary: Get users of the current company administrator's company

post.summary: Create a user in the company admin's company, organization and existing billing account

delete.summary: Mark a company user as deleted

get.summary: Get a user of the current company

put.summary: Update a company user's profile, without changing organization or billing

post.summary: Create a password reset link for a company user
Send a company user a password reset email

put.summary: Replace company user's authentication and MFA overrides
Set a company user's password with password strength validation

post.summary: Remove a company user's password; configured TOTP must be reset first

put.summary: Set Company Admin and Impersonator roles, preserving all other roles

post.summary: Unlink a company user's account at Microsoft, Google or the company's OIDC provider

put.summary: Activate or disable a company user

post.summary: Reset a company user's TOTP and recovery codes

ip.description: IP address from which token was requested

lastUsed.description: When the token was last used

token.description: Token string used for Bearer auth

aggregateState.description: Aggregated Account state (ACTIVE only if admin state and billing state are ACTIVE)

billingState.description: Billing Account state (Depend on balance and max credit)

billingType.description: Type of billing for this account

Company.description: Company membership, independent of organization and billing account

noCompany.description: The system company of users without a real company: always exists, cannot be renamed

partnerAccessEnabled.description: The company lets the partner access its users' accounts (impersonate, issue tokens, change the email), if a user allowed it too; changed in the company settings

CompanyAuthenticationSettings.description: Sign-in and MFA settings of the company users; users may have their own overrides, see UserAuthenticationSettings

allowGoogleAuth.description: Allow signing up and signing in with Google

allowMicrosoftAuth.description: Allow signing up and signing in with Microsoft

allowOidcAuth.description: Allow signing in with the company's OIDC provider

allowPasswordAuth.description: Allow signing up and signing in with password

totpEnforced.description: Require users with password auth to configure TOTP

totpGracePeriodDays.description: Number of days during which user can skip configuring required TOTP, 0 - required immediately

totpRecoveryCodesEnabled.description: Allow issuing and using TOTP recovery codes

CompanyOidcSettings.description: OIDC provider to sign in company users. Issuer URL, client ID and secret must be set, or all fields empty to remove it

clientId.description: Client ID registered in the provider

clientSecret.description: Client secret, never returned. Empty to keep the current one

displayName.description: Name of the provider shown to users

issuerUrl.description: Issuer URL, endpoints are taken from its /.well-known/openid-configuration

scopes.description: Space-separated scopes to request, e.g. "openid email profile"

CompanySettings.description: Settings of the company: sign-in, MFA, OIDC provider and partner access

authentication.description: Sign-in and MFA settings of the company users

oidc.description: OIDC provider to sign in company users. In a response all its fields are empty if it is not configured; in a request null or all fields empty removes it

partnerAccessEnabled.description: Allow the partner to manage users of the company; if false, the partner cannot manage them whatever their own consent is

CompanyUser.description: User of the company as seen by the company administrator

authentication.description: User's own sign-in and MFA overrides, null if everything is inherited from the company

serviceAccount.description: Service account: has no password and no linked SSO, works only with API tokens

ssoOnly.description: The user has no password and signs in only with linked SSO

CreateCompanyUserRequest.description: Request payload for creating a user by a company admin; organization, billing and company are defined by the company

allowPartnerManage.description: Whether partner administrators may act as the new user (impersonation, tokens). Not set means false: the company admin must allow it explicitly

payUrl.description: URL where user should be redirected for payment

amount.description: Amount in that currency (use negative for refunds)

hasAzureManagedIdentityConfig.description: True if Azure Managed Identity configuration exists

UpdateCompanyUserRequest.description: Request payload for updating a user by a company admin; organization, billing and company cannot be changed here

account.description: Billing Account associated with this user

actualAdminManagedSettings.description: Actual settings: authentication/MFA from user then company; operational settings from user then partner then organization

actualLimits.description: Actual limits thar are currently in force

adminManagedSettings.description: Admin-managed settings defined for this user

billingServerAccountId.description: ID of this user's billing account on an external billing server

company.description: Company membership, independent of organization and billing account

companyAuthenticationSettings.description: Authentication and MFA defaults of the user's company

deleteRequested.description: If not null - time when the user requested to delete his or her account

externalId.description: External ID of the user, if specified

impersonationKind.description: In /user/current only: who acts as the user, null if the user signed in; otherwise by whose rights the user is impersonated

inheritedAdminManagedSettings.description: Inherited defaults: company authentication/MFA and partner/organization operational settings

isServiceAccount.description: Indicates that this the account is not intended for direct sign-in, but it can be used via impersonation

oidcProviderName.description: Name of OIDC provider of the user's company, null if the company has not configured it

oidcSub.description: Subject at OIDC provider of the user's company

oidcUserName.description: User name (email) at OIDC provider of the user's company

organizationAdminManagedSettings.description: Operational defaults defined by user's organization

partnerAdminManagedSettings.description: Operational defaults defined by user's partner, null if the user has no partner

passwordIsEmpty.description: Indicates that this user does not have a password

pristine.description: Indicates that nobody has used the account yet: the user has never signed in and no user the user allowed has impersonated the user. With unset allowPartnerManage the partner may act as a pristine user only

recoveryCodesConfigured.description: Indicates that active recovery codes exist for this user

signUpCode.description: Sign up code that the user used when signing up

termsAccepted.description: Indicates if user has accepted terms. User must accept terms before using web console if requireLicense is configured for console. Does not restrict API access.

totpConfigured.description: Indicates that the user has configured TOTP, so password sign in requires a TOTP code

totpSetupDeadline.description: Time until which the user can postpone configuring enforced TOTP, null if the user does not have to configure TOTP

totpSetupRequired.description: Indicates that the user has to configure TOTP because it is required by admin-managed settings for users with a password

username.description: Username, always the same as user's email

UserAdminManagedSettings.description: Null means inherited: authentication/MFA user - company; operational settings user - partner - organization

authentication.description: Authentication and MFA settings, inherited from the user's company when unset

operational.description: Operational settings, inherited from the user's partner then organization when unset

UserAuthenticationSettings.description: Authentication and MFA overrides; null fields inherit from the user's company

allowGoogleAuth.description: Allow signing up and signing in with Google

allowMicrosoftAuth.description: Allow signing up and signing in with Microsoft

allowOidcAuth.description: Allow signing in with the company's OIDC provider

allowPasswordAuth.description: Allow signing up and signing in with password

totpEnforced.description: Require users with password auth to configure TOTP

totpGracePeriodDays.description: Number of days during which user can skip configuring required TOTP, 0 - required immediately

totpRecoveryCodesEnabled.description: Allow issuing and using TOTP recovery codes

UserOperationalSettings.description: Operational settings: user - partner - organization; null fields inherit from the next level

allowAwsPrivateLinkInterface.description: Allow AWS PrivateLink Interface Endpoint. Cannot be changed by partner

allowDropboxDestinations.description: Allow migrations to Dropbox. Cannot be changed by partner

allowRemovingConflictingBucketNotificati.description: Allow removing conflicting bucket notification rules when creating/editing continuous pipelines

allowSelectingEnginesLocationForPipeline.description: Allow user to select location for engines when creating/editing pipelines

migrationLogLevel.description: Log level for migrations. Null on organization level to use the level from engine configuration

migrationReportLevel.description: Migration report level for migrations. Null on organization level to use the level from engine configuration

pipelineMigrationLogLevel.description: Log level for pipeline migrations. Null on organization level to use the level from engine configuration

pipelineMigrationReportLevel.description: Migration report level for pipeline migrations. Null on organization level to use the level from engine configuration

skipAutoUndeploy.description: Skip auto undeploy of engines (only for debug). Cannot be changed by partner

displayName.description: Display name (usually first and last name)

email.description: Email address, always matches the username

allowPartnerManage.description: Indicates that the user allowed his or her partner to impersonate and manage user's account. Null when not decided yet; null in an update keeps the current value

sendNews.description: Indicates tha the user agreed to receive news and updates

sendNotifications.description: Indicates that we should send system notifications to the user
